# Current Synthesis

## Executive Summary

## Synthesis by Domain

### AI and Technology

AI and technology synthesis now centers operational fit: models, agents, infrastructure, data integration, verification, permissions, creative authorship, and human accountability determine whether capability becomes value or risk.

### Business and Markets

- Learning sources treat durable skill as active work: [[SelfTestingMemoryPractice]], [[DesirableDifficulty]], [[SelfDirectedLearning]], and [[LearningExperienceDesign]] preserve recall, reasoning, curiosity, and correction rather than treating fluent answers as enough.
